payload.claim: `docs/evidence/2026-11-14-spec-chain-feedback.md` states the SA-0389 writer "had applied all 14 [wrong versions] in its prototype" to answer a reviewer's concern, yet empirical testing shows the landed witness does not actually kill the startswith-widening wrong version this spec targets.
